notes.title: V 1.0.2 Update Notes
notes.content:
This update focuses on the [b]Nutopia_Config.json[/b].

[list]
[*]Now, you can adjust the initial items of Nutopia by Nutopia_Config.json, which may be quite useful for reducing repetitive file operations.
[*]The method of determining the content of Nutopia_Config.json has changed.
[*]Fixed the bug where duplicate statements appeared in some plots.
[*]Fixed the bug where text display in Hope.exe was incorrect in Traditional Chinese operating systems.
[*]Fixed some typos.
[/list]

notes.title: V 1.0.1 Update notes
notes.content:
It's a update focused on bug fixes.  
- Now, if Vincent is not encountered after multiple restarts, the root folder will automatically pop up at the end of the day.  
- Fixed some bugs about Nutopia_Config.json.  
- Fixed the bug that completed notes would not reset in certain situations.  
- Fixed the bug that Vincent sometimes had abnormal scenes when wearing glasses.  
- Fixed the bug that some scenes were abnormal when Teddy wore glasses.  
- Fixed some bugs that occurred in the English version.  
- Fixed some typos.

tags.bug: - Now, if Vincent is not encountered after multiple restarts, the root folder will automatically pop up at the end of the day.
- Fixed the bug that completed notes would not reset in certain situations.

- Fixed the bug that some scenes were abnormal when Teddy wore glasses.
- Fixed some bugs that occurred in the English version.

notes.title: Update notes for 9/23
notes.content:
The first update for Picnic Syndrome on Steam!
- Introduced the Nutopia_Config.json file! It allows you to modify some settings in Nutopia. Currently, it features the display of location and time, more functionalities will be added in future updates.
- Slightly adjusted some achievements and modified the description text.
- Some bugs fixed.
- Some typos corrected.
